## Title

**`lca_entropy` --** Calculates an entropy statistic for latent class analysis (LCA) models

## General syntax

`lca_entropy` `,` [options]

<span id="overview"></span>

## Overview

`lca_entropy` calculates an entropy statistic for latent class analysis (LCA) models. The LCA must have been fit using `gsem` with the `lclass( )` option.

<span id="required"></span>

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `model(string)` | specifies the name of saved model estimates to use. See `estimates store` for saving model estimates. By default, `lca_entropy` will use the `gsem` estimates in memory. If the relevant model estimates are not in memory, you must specify their name. |
| `decimals(#)` | changes the number of decimal places reported for the entropy statistic. The default is 3. Any integer between 1 - 5 is allowed. |

## Examples

```stata
use http://www.stata-press.com/data/r15/gsem_lca1, clear
gsem ( -> accident play insurance stock), logit lclass(C 2)
lca_entropy
```

## Returns

The entropy statistics is returned as r(entropy).

## References

The entropy statistic is calculated using the formula shown in Collins and Lanza (2010) page 75.

Collins, Linda M. and Stephanie T. Lanza. 2010. *Latent Class and Latent Transition Analysis*. Wiley.
